name: git_release_notes
description: Analyze a GitHub release URL or repo URL and generate concise release notes with commit/PR/issue breakdown, risk flags, and optional canvas + stash output. Use when user asks 'what changed in this release', 'summarize latest release', or wants upgrade impact from GitHub releases.

target.description: GitHub repo URL, release URL, or owner/repo. Examples: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases/tag/v2026.2.25

tag.description: Optional release tag override (e.g. v2026.2.25). If omitted, uses tag from release URL or latest release.

mode.description: quick = fast summary, deep = adds PR/issue context and README excerpt.

include_prs.description: Include linked pull request details (default true).

max_commits.description: Maximum commits to analyze from compare API (default 25, max 100).

save_to_canvas.description: Create a canvas page with the full markdown report (default true).

save_to_stash.description: Save markdown report to stash for sharing/follow-up (default true).
